zh: 电路已清空。可以点"撤销"恢复。
en: Circuit cleared. Click "Undo" to restore it.

zh: 这一列在两根线之间已经有门了，换一列试试。
en: This column already has a gate between the two wires; try another column.

zh: 黑盒固定在这里，不能移动或删除。
en: The black box is fixed here and cannot be moved or removed.

zh: 现在点第 §0§ 列的另一根线§1§。再点一次同一格取消。
en: Now click the other wire in column §0§§1§. Click the same cell again to cancel.

zh: 点空格放门；两比特门先点控制位，再点同一列的目标位；点已放的门删除它；点上方的步骤号查看那一步之后的状态。
en: Click an empty cell to place a gate; for a two-qubit gate, click the control first, then the target in the same column; click a placed gate to remove it; click a step number above to see the state after that step.

zh: 查看第 §0§ 步之后的状态
条长 = 概率，颜色 = 振幅的相位：
en: Bar length = probability, color = phase of the amplitude:

zh: 真炸弹的情形：各结果的概率加起来，就是光子还没引爆炸弹的概率，现在是 §0§。
en: With a live bomb: the probabilities of the outcomes add up to the probability that the photon has not yet set off the bomb, currently §0§.

zh: 测量按延迟测量原理处理：这里显示的是测量之前的叠加态。测量过的比特之后只当控制位，所以结果与真的先测量完全相同。
en: Measurements are handled by the principle of deferred measurement: what is shown here is the superposition before measuring. A measured qubit is afterwards used only as a control, so the result is exactly the same as measuring first.

zh: Bloch 球画的是单个比特的约化态。与别的比特纠缠时，向量会缩进球里。
en: The Bloch spheres show the reduced state of each single qubit. When a qubit is entangled with others, its vector shrinks into the ball.

zh: 你的电路里有 §0§ 颗炸弹：已经换成"量子芝诺：分 N 步转"，N = §1§，光路设成完美的。把丢光子的概率调上去试试。
en: Your circuit has §0§ bombs: switched to "Quantum Zeno: N small steps" with N = §1§, on a perfect loop. Now try raising the photon loss probability.

zh: 四个盒子、一个奖品：转一步就测中。把量子比特数调大，看看要转几步。
en: Four boxes, one prize: one step of rotation and the measurement hits. Increase the number of qubits and see how many steps it takes.

zh: 你拨的四个角度（§0§）已经交给"纠缠光子 · 四个角度"：一局 200 回合，跑 2000 局。
en: Your four angles (§0§) have been handed to "Entangled photons · four angles": 200 rounds per episode, 2000 episodes.

zh: 去 ⑰ 炸弹检测：让规则一次测几千颗
en: Go to ⑰ Bomb testing: let a rule test thousands of bombs

zh: 去 ⑯ 量子搜索：盒子多到一百万个时怎么办
en: Go to ⑯ Quantum search: what to do with a million boxes

zh: 把这组角度交给 ⑮ Bell 游戏里的规则
en: Hand these angles to a rule in ⑮ Bell game

zh: 去 ⑮ Bell 游戏：两人各拿一个这样的光子
en: Go to ⑮ Bell game: each player holds one such photon

zh: 调好四个角度之后点"检验"。
en: Set the four angles, then click "Check".

zh: 摆好电路之后点"检验"。判定会把"状态"里列出的每一种情形都跑一遍。
en: Build the circuit, then click "Check". The judge runs every case listed under "State".

zh: 已用 §0§ 个门 · 参考解 §1§ 个门
用了 §0§ 个门，比参考解（§1§ 个）还少。
en: §0§ gates used, fewer than the reference solution (§1§).

zh: 用了 §0§ 个门 · 参考解 §1§ 个门§2§
· 再精简一些可以拿三星
en: · trim it down a little for three stars

zh: 离量子力学的上限还有距离，看看提示 2。
en: Still short of the quantum limit; see hint 2.

zh: 第一步 · 经典的答法
16 张确定的答法表里，最好的也只赢 3 格，即 75%。事先共享随机数，只是在这些答法表之间抽签，平均不会更高。
en: Of the 16 deterministic answer tables, even the best wins only 3 cells, that is 75%. Sharing random numbers in advance only draws lots among these tables, and the average cannot be higher.
Win rate of the quantum strategy §0§
As polarizer angles: α₀ = §0§, α₁ = §1§, β₀ = §2§, β₁ = §3§.

zh: 角度以 π/16 为一格
图是 Bloch 球的 x–z 截面。沿角度 θ 测量，对应球面上从 |0⟩ 转过 2θ 的方向；实线是 Alice 的两个设置，虚线是 Bob 的。
en: The figure is the x–z cross-section of the Bloch sphere. Measuring at angle θ corresponds to the direction on the sphere turned 2θ away from |0⟩; solid lines are Alice's two settings, dashed lines Bob's.
Win rate of the quantum strategy

zh: 还没有超过经典的上限 75%。
en: Not yet above the classical limit of 75%.

zh: 十关，从叠加到 Bell 不等式。点格子放门，看振幅和 Bloch 球怎么变，再点"检验"。炸弹、四选一、打破 75% 这三关做完，可以去对应的量子玩法里让规则跑几千局。
en: Ten levels, from superposition to the Bell inequality. Click cells to place gates, watch the amplitudes and Bloch spheres change, then click "Check". After the bomb, four-way search and beat-75% levels, you can go to the matching quantum game and let a rule run thousands of episodes.

zh: quantum circuit 量子 电路 谜题 量子比特 纠缠 叠加 Bell Grover 炸弹 隐形传态
en: quantum circuit puzzle qubit entanglement superposition Bell Grover bomb teleportation

zh: 十关：相对相位、换基、纠缠、三次异或、Deutsch 算法、不碰炸弹、四选一、超密编码、隐形传态、打破 75%。和三套量子玩法用的是同一个模拟器。
en: Ten levels: relative phase, change of basis, entanglement, three XORs, Deutsch's algorithm, the untouched bomb, four-way search, superdense coding, teleportation, beating 75%. They use the same simulator as the three quantum games.
